name: Rara Lake Trek
sub_region: Mugu District (with Jumla), Karnali Province; Rara National Park

difficulty.notes: Fly-in version via Talcha is short and gentle (2-4 hrs walk to the lake, optional Murma Top viewpoint). The classic walk-in from Jumla adds 4-5 days over forested ridges (Ghurchi Lagna approx. 3,450 m; Danfe Lagna approx. 3,700 m on some routes) and is moderate-to-challenging.

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu, fly-in via Nepalgunj and Talcha
duration_days.notes: Add 1-3 buffer days for weather-dependent Nepalgunj-Talcha flights. Classic Jumla loop (Jumla - Chere Chaur - Chala Chaur - Sinja - Goru Singhe - Rara - Pina - Bumra - Jumla) is approx. 10 trek days; overall 10-12 days Kathmandu-Kathmandu.

itinerary.route: Nepalgunj - Talcha (flight, approx. 35 min) - walk to Rara Lake

itinerary.notes: Nepal's largest lake; within Rara National Park.

itinerary.route: Hike to Murma Top viewpoint and return
itinerary.notes: Murma Top approx. 3,710-3,726 m; Chuchemara Danda (approx. 4,039 m) is a longer alternative viewpoint.

best_seasons.notes: NTB lists February-April and October-November as best season for Rara National Park. Monsoon disrupts mountain flights; winter is cold with possible snow.

permits.name: Rara National Park entry
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

guide_requirements: Rara is not on the NTB list of named routes requiring a licensed guide and agency TIMS (that list covers Kanchenjunga, Makalu, Everest, Langtang, Manaslu, Annapurna, Mustang, Dolpo, Humla etc.). The April 2023 guide rule was described by the U.S. Embassy as applying to national parks and protected areas generally, so requirements for Rara should be confirmed with the agency. No restricted area permit is needed for the standard Rara route (Mugu's restricted area is Mugumakarmarong RM, not Rara).

flights: Nepalgunj - Talcha (approx. 35 min; small aircraft, weather-sensitive)
Alternative: Nepalgunj - Jumla for the walk-in route
drives: Overland alternative via Surkhet - Gamgadhi on long dirt roads (approx. 2 days)
logistics.notes: Lodges/homestays near the lake and on the fly-in route; camping on some sections of the Jumla walk-in.

highlights: Rara Lake, Nepal's largest lake, at approx. 2,990 m
Murma Top panorama over the lake to distant Himalaya
Rara National Park forests (blue pine, spruce, rhododendron) and wildlife (red panda, musk deer, Himalayan black bear)
Winter migratory waterfowl (NTB lists over 200 bird species)
Optional Sinja valley, historic Khas Malla capital, on the Jumla route
risks: Weather-related cancellation of Nepalgunj-Talcha / Jumla flights
Remote far-west location with limited medical facilities

acclimatization.notes: Low altitude (under 3,000 m sleeping) means no formal acclimatization day is needed on the fly-in version; the Jumla route has sleeping-altitude gains of approx. 500 m on some days.

unverified: Whether a licensed guide is mandatory for Rara (not on the NTB named-route list).
Whether a TIMS card is checked/required on the Rara route.
Talcha airstrip altitude approx. 2,720 m (single source).
Murma Top altitude quoted 3,710 m and 3,726 m by different sources.
